scope: Archive 009, the key-item and sub-chip descriptions Rockman reads out in the PET. Identical in both revisions.
provenance: Claude translator-authored Japanese to Korean, 2026-09-20; no independent review yet
tone: Rockman explaining an item to Netto: friendly 반말 with 〜야/〜네.
notes: The dot used for the game's ellipsis is katakana range, so the Korean uses three full stops. The middle dot in 'L・Rボタン' is likewise katakana range and becomes a slash.

revisions: 2026-09-25: the two story-data item names were 해님/달님, but every narration line that names the same spirit (batches 021, 024, 027, 028) says 오텐코 님, so the chapter-2 blank read 해님 and the next chapter 오텐코 님 for one character. Renamed to 오텐코 님, and the decoy おこんてさま (a て/こ swap of the real name) to 오코텐 님, which keeps the swap the puzzle is built on.
2026-09-27: area numbers join their name (에리어3), as the Japanese writes エリア3 and as 86 lines already did; this batch had the spaced form.
2026-09-27: ヌポポぞう is 누포포상 in one word, as batches 029 to 063 write it; this batch had 누포포 상. Glossary exe4-term-042/043.
2026-09-27: ウィザーモンキー is written 위저몽키 without a space, as 위저독 is; this batch had 위저 몽키. Glossary exe4-term-036.

2026-09-28: the memo and hint data riddles, deferred since this batch was written because their answers were not established, are resolved. The memo reads backwards line by line: びなのりどみ／んさありえんうた is みどりのなび たうんえりあさん, a green navi in Town Area 3. The hint data reads as a spiral, as its next line うずまき says, clockwise from the top-right corner and down first: がしてみるは／さ!なだんな／をかなのばた is はなたばのなかをさがしてみるんだな!. Both answers use every letter of the source. The Korean is scrambled the same way: 비내 록초／3어리에 운타 reads backwards as 초록 내비 타운 에리어3, and 보는거꽃／아!야다／찾을속발 reads by the same spiral as 꽃다발속을찾아보는거야!. The story gate now holds these and the kidnapper riddle to their readings.
